violations.why: Interrupt 1 stays enabled after line 17, so irq_quiver (addData) can increment v_umber between the task's check and its reset to 0.
Once irq_quiver has run and enabled interrupt 2, irq_raptor can preempt the task between the check and the reset and modify v_umber.
Before line 16 interrupts are enabled, so irq_pylon can increment v_umber after the task's write at line 35. The task's later read at line 18 then sees a value it did not write.
irq_quiver can run during init() and increment v_umber between the task's write at line 35 and its read at line 18.
